labs.research_summary: Research at the intersection of reproductive biology and tissue engineering to understand the immune-endocrine mechanisms driving uterine reproductive health and disease. We are particularly interested in understanding how inflammation negatively, and positively, impacts reproductive function across the lifespan. Our lab builds miniature uterine tissues using tissue engineering approaches and human tissues to study tissue regeneration, endometriosis, infertility, reproductive aging (i.e., menopause) and tissue-tissue crosstalk.

notes: IMPORTANT: targets.csv gives each engineering department a different field_department_tid query param, but it does NOT filter -- confirmed by comparing two tid values byte-for-byte identical. The directory covers all engineering departments plus secondary appointments, part-time lecturers and affiliates from several other Tufts schools. This file's labs were bucketed from ONE full crawl (8 pages, 374 people) by each person's own 'department-title' tag shown on their card. Titles of Professor/Associate/Assistant Professor and Research [Assistant/Associate] Professor were treated as PI-led labs; Part-time/Teaching/Adjunct/Affiliate/Visiting/Emeritus titles went to non_lab_people.
